purpose: Observed source values only; not paragraph function predictions.

sources.method: Regex count of AZ attributes in every .az-scixml file; includes A-S abstract and body sentence or item tags. Counts are not paragraphs.

XML parse each .xmi; count MatSci_Sentence elements and exact ContentInformation and StructureInformation attributes independently. These are annotation elements including overlapping spans and different layers, not unique sentences; paper projected label counts have a different denominator.
mismatches: Guide names EXPERIMENTS/PREPARATION and EXPERIMENTS/CHARACTERIZATION serialize as Exp_Preparation and Exp_Characterization.
Raw Exp_Preparation 1470 elements vs paper Table 8 projected sentence count 962; no one-to-one equivalence.
MEASUREMENT and QUAL_MEASUREMENT are present as ContentInformation values but absent from inspected AZ codebook; excluded from function mappings pending separate layer definitions.
SYNTHESIS PROCEDURE is named in codebook list without located definition; exact value was not observed in XMI.
EXPLANATION/ASSUMPTION and EXPLANATION/HYPOTHESIS occur in raw XMI but paper Table 8 lacks separate projected counts.
Extra structural annotations and spelling variants appear in raw XMI; do not silently normalize or infer meaning.

sources.method: JSON parse one dependency tree; counts include artificial root and apply only to this example, not corpus-wide.
mismatches: Data serialize examples using lowercase or prefixes such as elab-aspect and elab-addition; paper Table 1 prints coarse and fine names. Relations link elementary discourse units and are not paragraph functions.

not_inspected: SciPara serialized pickle was not executed. MuLMS paper counts are quoted as source claims in scientific-crosswalk.json rather than recomputed from model projection.
